title: velocirepo: data health
description:
velocirepo checks the data every night. This issue lists the findings that are open; it's rewritten by every run.

| | Check | Where | What | Since | ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/shiny-r rstudio/shiny | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 24 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-10 | `17effd5faf59` |
| ⚠️ | `data.integrity` | github/connect-actions | duplicate: 2 times in events/github/connect-actions/2026-11-02.jsonl | 2026-11-07 | `53d9df8577b3` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/shiny rstudio/shiny | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 24 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-10 | `5a659b61e71c` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/py-shinywidgets posit-dev/py-shinywidgets | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 21 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-10 | `a4798b102816` |
| ⚠️ | `data.integrity` | github/connect-actions | line 4: duplicate of line 3 | 2026-11-10 | `c87c1ecabc49` |

To accept a finding, add its ID to `velocirepo/checks.toml`:

```toml
[[accept]]
id = "…"
reason = "…"
```

Last updated by https://github.com/posit-dev/devrel-io/actions/runs/42792093531

title: Include more Posit R packages
description: I've noticed that tidymodels packages and commons are not included in this data. Happy to send a PR to make that happen for that github org and for that package specifically, but I'm also wondering if we could apply some rule that would have caught both of those and added them automatically.
